title: Upgrade x509-cert 0.2 -> 0.3
description: Used for the SVID certificate path. Coupled to the RustCrypto release train, so may need to move together with sha2/hkdf.
notes:
Bumped 0.2.5 -> 0.3.0 and it builds, but the real finding is that x509-cert has ZERO use statements anywhere in the workspace. persona-core declares it; no code imports it. The X.509 signer is a documented stub (persona-core/src/signer.rs:117-120, blocked on ring <-> RustCrypto interop, refs persona-4qm).

Recommendation: delete the dependency rather than carry it. When the X.509 signer is actually implemented, re-add at whatever version is current then, which is strictly better than maintaining a stale unused pin. Left in place at 0.3.0 pending Mark's call, since removing a declared dependency is a scope decision rather than an upgrade.
close_reason: Fixed and verified. See commit 7c013e3. .3 closed separately: x509-cert bumped to 0.3.0; deletion recommendation retained in its notes.
